packageRules.description: Major upgrades are not opened automatically. Tick the box in the Dependency Dashboard issue to request one.
Longhorn holds app data and must be upgraded one minor version at a time, with backups first. After each step, raise allowedVersions by one minor.
Images on a floating tag (latest) are pinned to a digest so a pod restart cannot silently change the version. Refreshed together once a month.
schedule: on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: The Lidarr image has a stray old tag, 8.1.2135, that sorts above every real release. Real Lidarr versions are 2.x and 3.x. Raise this if Lidarr ever reaches version 8.
Rana is built and released by its own pipeline.
